name: Josabad
title: Levite and Temple Gatekeeper
summary: Josabad was a Levite who played an important role in the period after the exile in Babylon. He was involved in the administration of temple offerings and service in the temple during the reforms of Ezra and Nehemiah. He is mentioned several times in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah as a trusted Levite responsible for the treasures of the temple and teaching the law.

keyEvents.title: Receiving Temple Treasures
keyEvents.description: Josabad was one of the Levites who received the silver, gold, and vessels brought from Babylon to the temple in Jerusalem. He helped weigh and record these valuable items.

keyEvents.title: Teaching the Law
keyEvents.description: Josabad was among the Levites who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it aloud to the assembly. He explained the law to the people while they stood in their places.

keyEvents.title: Overseeing External Temple Work
keyEvents.description: Josabad had oversight of the external work at God's house, which involved practical management and administration of the temple's daily operations.

keyEvents.title: Participation in Ezra's reforms
keyEvents.description: Josabad was part of the group of Levites who supported Ezra's reform efforts to restore proper worship and adherence to the Law of Moses in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Dedication of Jerusalem's Wall
keyEvents.description: Josabad participated in the spiritual life of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership and was among the prominent Levites who served in connection with the rebuilding and dedication.
